title: ContractError
description: Explicit numerical discriminant mappings for SoroScope smart contract error codes.

error_codes.name: NotInitialized
error_codes.description: Contract has not been initialized yet.

error_codes.name: Unauthorized
error_codes.description: Caller is not authorized to perform this operation.

error_codes.name: InsufficientBalance
error_codes.description: Account balance is insufficient for requested transaction.

error_codes.name: SlippageExceeded
error_codes.description: Slippage tolerance was exceeded during swap.

error_codes.name: NoPendingFeeUpdate
error_codes.description: No pending fee update was found.

error_codes.name: TimelockNotElapsed
error_codes.description: Timelock period has not yet elapsed.

error_codes.name: InvalidOraclePrice
error_codes.description: Price returned by oracle is invalid or stale.

error_codes.name: Paused
error_codes.description: Contract execution is currently paused by emergency guard.
